ClientResponses.Response: Hello! Congratulations on your first Weber! We are sorry to hear that your experience did not match your expectations. Flare-ups are a byproduct of grilling over live fire. The drippings falling down create the flare ups. While they can never be eliminated completely, below are some steps for reducing them: https://consumer-care.weber.com/hc/en-us/articles/360023841411-How-do-I-prevent-flare-ups- Do not hesitate to contact us if you have any other questions!

Results.ReviewText: I thought Webber grills were supposed to be a premium grill.  Not so, I thought I would upgrade and purchased the spirit grill. It’s been disappointing, grease builds up and causes more flare ups than I have ever had on any gas grill I’ve owned in the past. the grease doesn’t drain away under the burners. I’ve never had a grill have issues like this one. Going to cut my losses and sell this while it looks good and get another brand.
Results.Title: Not what I was expecting

Results.ReviewText: I waited a long time to get this grill, and now that I have it, I wish I wouldn't have waited so long. It cooks food very well, since the heat is evenly distributed. It gets hot fast, so you don't need to have a lot of time to grill. It doesn't seem to use as much fuel as my previous grill either, so that's an added bonus. This grill is perfect, and helps me crank out top notch food.
Results.Title: Finally got my Weber

Results.ReviewText: Love the heat and how easy it is to be consistently good with my grilling.
Results.Title: Very hot, consistent grill

Results.ReviewText: I wish it had an extendable shelf like my old Genesis. Still, it heats up fast and temp is easy to control. Vertical heating elements unlike my old one which takes some adjustment but now I love it.

Results.ReviewText: I highly recommend Weber not only for their quality products but for their quality service to stand behind their products. This will keep me coming back to choose a Weber grill over all other competitors.

Results.ReviewText: I had a Weber Grill that lasted 20 years of ill treatment. The Spirit E-310 is superior in every way. It cooks uniformly and browns our chicken to picture perfect and it tastes great. The full propane tank is far too heavy to lift into the cabinet and then up to the hook. I'll wait until it is less full before I try to lift it at that difficult angle again. Also the directions neglect to inform the user to turn the tank off after each use.
Results.Title: Picture and taste perfect grilling on Weber Spirit

Results.ReviewText: Excellent grill, absolutely love it! Replaced a charcoal grill with this, my first gas grill, and will never go back to charcoal! Grilling temps are easy to control and very precise. Everything I’ve grilled so far has come out perfectly.
Results.Title: Excellent grill!

Results.ReviewText: Weber has the best warranty service hands down! I had no issues getting parts covered, snapped a picture and 2 days later was back to grilling.
Results.Title: Don't buy another brand!

Results.ReviewText: Enjoy it, right size for gatherings up tp 8 people. I wish the side tables went down without screaming them off.
Results.Title: Griller

Results.ReviewText: This sturdy grill heats up fast and provides for even cooking.  I live in a windy area and the flames are protected, so even in the middle of winter I can get the perfect temperature and have a fantastic cooking experience.  The cooking area is massive, and I easily could fit six 1.25lb ribeyes, or 16 homemade burgers at the same time.  Having three burners is great for when you're cooking only for two people as you can cook off heat or even set it up as a convection.  Overall I am very pleased with this grill and would (and have) recommend this to anyone in the market for a new grill.  Weber customer service has been great 70% of the time, with the other 30% being mediocre but not bad.  If you need service, call them, and if you don't have a positive experience just call back to get someone new.
Results.Title: Perfect grill for individuals or for a party.

Results.ReviewText: This is a very nice grill. I also have the same model but an older version that is 12 years old and still works great. Only one thing I could see be modified is the propane gas hose coupler needs to be about 4-6” longer to give a little more flex when connecting to the tank. It’s a tight fit depending on the make of the tank.
Results.Title: Great Grill

46510001.Name: Spirit E-310 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
46510001.Description:
Add flavor to the menu with a Spirit E-310. It’s the ideal grill for entertaining a small crowd or a perfect solution to any family meal. Place serving trays and spices on the side tables so that everything you need is where you are, when you need it. With features such as porcelain-enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 424 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
